description: List the organization's library documents (brand guidelines, product specs, personas) available to attach to a brief via attached_document_ids. Filter by category, status, or a filename substring.

anyOf.description:
Top-level category chosen by the user at upload time (Q6/Q7).

No automatic classification: the value here is canonical and chosen
by the human uploader. Reclassification is delete + re-upload.
anyOf.title: DocumentCategory

anyOf.description:
Lifecycle states for a knowledge-library document.

Typical happy path:
``uploaded → extracting → summarizing → ready``.

Any stage may transition to ``failed`` (see ``failed_stage`` for which
stage failed). ``ready → archived`` soft-removes the document from the
library while retaining the row for audit; archived documents are
excluded from list and detail reads.
anyOf.title: DocumentStatus
